overall_summary: Analysis of the performance data reveals that the 'self respect' topic consistently drives higher view counts (ranging between 28 to 41 views) compared to other emotional themes like 'ओवरथिंकिंग' or 'रात के ख्याल' which struggle below 20 views. Specifically, modern smartphone micro-interactions related to boundaries (e.g., status lists, blue ticks, pinned chats) perform best. However, absolute view numbers are still low across the board, signaling a need to refine hook pacing while leaning into the proven self-respect narrative.
